body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Induction Dyanamics presented ''SolidDrive'' that delivers high quality sound when it is attached to any kind of solid material such as a wall, glass or table. So, for example, if you put it at the back of a window or a corner side of the wall, sound comes from the entire glass or the wall while media source are invisible.
It is 2.28-inch in diameter and 2.08-inch high at mere 520g in weight. It could be useful for interior design.
